  def register_workflow(self, workflow: WorkflowDefinition) -> None
  def remove_hook(self, hook: LifecycleHook) -> bool
  def remove_instance(self, instance_id: str) -> bool
  def schedule_timer(self, instance_id: str, delay_seconds: float, next_step_id: str) -> None
  def start(self, workflow_id: str, initial_context: dict[str, Any] | None = None, instance_id: str | None = None, max_seconds: float | None = None, wait: bool = True) -> str
